requirements.content: The algorithm module shall provide a main execution handler (ALGO_MainFunction) that manages the cyclic execution of registered algorithms based on their configured cycle times
The algorithm module shall provide an initialization unlock mechanism (ALGO_UnlockInitialization) that signals the system to run algorithm initialization routines
The algorithm module shall monitor calculation execution time of different algorithms to detect runtime violations
The algorithm cycle time configuration shall be a multiple of the ALGO_TICK_ms (100ms) base tick time
The algorithm initialization function shall return either STD_OK (successful initialization) or STD_NOT_OK (failed initialization)
An algorithm exceeding its maximum calculation duration shall be blocked from further execution
The algorithm module shall support the following states: UNINITIALIZED, READY, RUNNING, BLOCKED, FAILED_INIT, and REINIT_REQUESTED
The algorithm index parameter for ALGO_MarkAsDone and ALGO_MarkAsReinit shall be validated to be within the configured algorithm array bounds
The algorithm base tick time shall be configured as ALGO_TICK_ms = 100ms for scheduling algorithm execution

Each algorithm task configuration shall include: current execution state, cycle time in ms, maximum calculation duration in ms, start timestamp, initialization function pointer, and computation function pointer
The moving average algorithm shall calculate current and power moving averages over multiple time windows: 1s, 5s, 10s, 30s, 60s, and a configurable interval
The configurable moving average duration for current measurement shall be MOVING_AVERAGE_DURATION_CURRENT_CONFIG_ms = 3000ms
The configurable moving average duration for power measurement shall be MOVING_AVERAGE_DURATION_POWER_CONFIG_ms = 3000ms
The moving average algorithm shall only use valid current measurements (invalidCurrentMeasurement flag equals 0) for calculations
The moving average algorithm shall only use valid power measurements (invalidPowerMeasurement flag equals 0) for calculations
The state estimation module shall provide wrapper functions for SOC, SOE, and SOH initialization that delegate to algorithm-specific implementations
The state estimation module shall provide a main function (SE_RunStateEstimations) that executes SOC, SOE, and SOH calculations in sequence
The state estimation module shall validate the stringNumber parameter to be less than BS_NR_OF_STRINGS for all initialization functions
The state estimation module shall write updated SOC, SOE, and SOH values to the database after calculation
The SOC counting algorithm shall calculate State of Charge using coulomb counting (Ah integration) based on current sensor measurements
The SOC initialization function shall validate that pSocValues pointer is not NULL
The SOC initialization function shall validate that stringNumber is less than BS_NR_OF_STRINGS
The SOC calculation function shall validate that pSocValues pointer is not NULL before processing
The SOC values shall be limited to the range 0.0% to 100.0% (SOC_MINIMUM_SOC_perc to SOC_MAXIMUM_SOC_perc)
The SOC module shall track minimum, maximum, and average SOC values per string
The SOC module shall recalibrate SOC values via voltage-based lookup table when the battery system is at rest (BMS_AT_REST)
The SOC lookup function shall return SOC percentage in range 0.0% to 100.0% based on cell voltage input in mV
The SOC module shall support coulomb counting from current sensor when available (ccPresent = true) or fallback to current integration
The SOC module shall persist SOC values to non-volatile memory (FRAM) for recovery after power cycle
The SOC module shall track charge throughput and discharge throughput in Ampere-seconds per string
The string capacity for SOC calculation shall be derived from BC_CAPACITY_mAh multiplied by BS_NR_OF_PARALLEL_CELLS_PER_CELL_BLOCK
The SOC lookup table shall use linear interpolation between voltage points and shall not extrapolate beyond table boundaries
The SOE counting algorithm shall calculate State of Energy using energy counting (Wh integration) based on current and voltage measurements
The SOE initialization function shall validate that pSoeValues pointer is not NULL
The SOE initialization function shall validate that stringNumber is less than BS_NR_OF_STRINGS
The SOE calculation function shall validate that pSoeValues pointer is not NULL before processing
The SOE values shall be limited to the range 0.0% to 100.0% (MINIMUM_SOE_PERC to MAXIMUM_SOE_PERC)
The SOE module shall track minimum, maximum, and average SOE values per string in both percentage and Wh units
The SOE module shall recalibrate SOE values via voltage-based lookup table when the battery system is at rest (BMS_AT_REST)
The SOE module shall support energy counting from current sensor when available (ec_present = true) or fallback to manual energy integration
The SOE module shall persist SOE values to non-volatile memory (FRAM) for recovery after power cycle
The SOE module shall track charge energy throughput and discharge energy throughput in Wh per string
The string energy for SOE calculation shall be derived from BC_ENERGY_Wh multiplied by BS_NR_OF_CELL_BLOCKS_PER_STRING and BS_NR_OF_PARALLEL_CELLS_PER_CELL_BLOCK
The SOE lookup table shall use linear interpolation between voltage points and shall not extrapolate beyond table boundaries
The SOH module shall calculate State of Health and provide minimum, maximum, and average SOH values per string
The SOH initialization function shall validate that pSohValues pointer is not NULL
The SOH initialization function shall validate that stringNumber is less than BS_NR_OF_STRINGS
The SOH calculation function shall validate that pSohValues pointer is not NULL before processing
The SOF trapezoid algorithm shall calculate State of Function (current derating) based on cell voltage and temperature limits using a trapezoidal profile
The SOF module shall calculate four current limits: continuous charge, peak charge, continuous discharge, and peak discharge currents
The SOF initialization (SOF_Init) shall calculate the derating curve parameters at startup using linear function parameter extraction
The SOF voltage-based current limit calculation shall validate that all pointer parameters are not NULL
The SOF temperature-based current limit calculation shall validate that all pointer parameters are not NULL
The SOF module shall set discharge current to zero when cell voltage is at or below the limit lower cell voltage threshold
The SOF module shall set charge current to zero when cell voltage is at or above the limit upper cell voltage threshold
The SOF module shall derate discharge current at low temperatures, allowing limp home current below cutoff temperature and zero current below limit temperature
The SOF module shall derate charge current at low temperatures, allowing zero current below limit temperature
The SOF module shall derate discharge current at high temperatures, setting to zero above limit temperature
The SOF module shall derate charge current at high temperatures, setting to zero above limit temperature
The SOF module shall calculate the minimum of voltage-based and temperature-based current limits as the final allowed current
The SOF module shall only calculate current limits for strings that are currently closed (connected)
The SOF module shall set all pack current limits to zero when a transition to ERROR state is active in the BMS state machine
The SOF pack current limits shall be calculated as the sum of minimum string currents across all closed strings
The SOF string current shall be limited to BS_MAXIMUM_STRING_CURRENT_mA maximum
The maximum continuous charge current shall be calculated from BC_CURRENT_MAX_CHARGE_MOL_mA multiplied by BS_NR_OF_PARALLEL_CELLS_PER_CELL_BLOCK
The maximum continuous discharge current shall be calculated from BC_CURRENT_MAX_DISCHARGE_MOL_mA multiplied by BS_NR_OF_PARALLEL_CELLS_PER_CELL_BLOCK
The limp home current shall be configured as SOF_STRING_CURRENT_LIMP_HOME_mA = 20000mA
The low temperature discharge cutoff shall be derived from BC_TEMPERATURE_MIN_DISCHARGE_MOL_ddegC
The low temperature discharge limit shall be derived from BC_TEMPERATURE_MIN_DISCHARGE_MSL_ddegC
The low temperature charge cutoff shall be derived from BC_TEMPERATURE_MIN_CHARGE_MOL_ddegC
The low temperature charge limit shall be derived from BC_TEMPERATURE_MIN_CHARGE_MSL_ddegC
The high temperature discharge cutoff shall be derived from BC_TEMPERATURE_MAX_DISCHARGE_MOL_ddegC
The high temperature discharge limit shall be derived from BC_TEMPERATURE_MAX_DISCHARGE_MSL_ddegC
The high temperature charge cutoff shall be derived from BC_TEMPERATURE_MAX_CHARGE_MOL_ddegC
The high temperature charge limit shall be derived from BC_TEMPERATURE_MAX_CHARGE_MSL_ddegC
The upper cell voltage cutoff for charge derating shall be derived from BC_VOLTAGE_MAX_MOL_mV
The upper cell voltage limit for charge derating shall be derived from BC_VOLTAGE_MAX_RSL_mV
The lower cell voltage cutoff for discharge derating shall be derived from BC_VOLTAGE_MIN_MOL_mV
The lower cell voltage limit for discharge derating shall be derived from BC_VOLTAGE_MIN_RSL_mV
The AFE driver shall provide a trigger function (AFE_TriggerIc) to advance the state machine for cyclic measurement operations.
The AFE driver shall provide an initialization function (AFE_Initialize) to initialize the analog front-end before measurements can begin.
The AFE driver shall provide a function (AFE_IsFirstMeasurementCycleFinished) to check if the first measurement cycle has been completed.
The AFE driver shall provide a function (AFE_StartMeasurement) to make initialization requests to the AFE state machine.
The AFE driver shall provide a function (AFE_RequestTemperatureRead) to request temperature readings from external temperature sensors on slave modules.
The AFE driver shall provide a function (AFE_RequestBalancingFeedbackRead) to request balancing feedback from the slave modules.
The AFE driver shall provide a function (AFE_RequestOpenWireCheck) to request open-wire detection on the specified string.
The AFE driver shall perform open-wire detection periodically with a configurable period (AFE_ERROR_OPEN_WIRE_PERIOD_ms = 30000ms).
The AFE driver shall use INT16_MAX as the default invalid cell voltage value when no valid measurement result can be read.
The AFE driver shall perform plausibility checks on cell voltage measurements to verify they are within the maximum and minimum operating limits of the AFE.
The cell voltage plausibility check function shall return STD_OK if the voltage is within plausible limits and STD_NOT_OK otherwise.
The AFE plausibility check shall assert that maximum plausible voltage is greater than minimum plausible voltage.
The AFE driver shall perform temperature plausibility checks to verify cell temperatures are within minimum and maximum plausible limits.
The temperature plausibility check shall assert that maximum plausible temperature is greater than or equal to minimum plausible temperature.
The AFE driver shall provide a DMA callback function (AFE_DmaCallback) to handle DMA block transfer completion for SPI communication.
The ADI ADES183x driver shall support daisy-chain communication with multiple analog front-end ICs using isoSPI interface.
The ADI driver shall notify the AFE task with ADI_DMA_SPI_FINISHED_NOTIFICATION_VALUE (0x50) when SPI transaction is complete.
The ADI driver shall implement a measurement cycle function (ADI_MeasurementCycle) that contains the sequence of measurement events.
The ADI driver shall support cell voltage measurements in the range of 2000mV to 4500mV.
The ADI driver shall support GPIO voltage measurements with a minimum value of 100mV.
The ADI driver shall validate that digital supply voltage VD is within 2754mV to 3528mV range.
The ADI driver shall validate that analog supply voltage VA is within 4512mV to 5486mV range.
The ADI driver shall validate that secondary reference voltage VREF2 is within 2985mV to 3015mV range.
The ADI driver shall monitor die temperature within -40 degC to 125 degC operating range.
The ADI driver shall use a transmission timeout of 10ms for interrupt-based SPI transmission.
The ADI driver shall wait 100us for isoSPI wakeup after sleep mode.
The ADI driver shall support up to 16 cells per IC (ADI_MAX_SUPPORTED_CELLS) with configurable cell inputs.
The ADI driver shall support exactly 10 GPIO inputs per module for temperature sensing.
The ADI driver shall track and validate CRC for each IC in the daisy-chain to ensure communication integrity (RequirementId: D7.1 V1R0 SIF-4.10.02.04).
The ADI driver shall maintain command counter validation for each IC to detect communication sequence errors (RequirementId: D7.1 V1R0 SIF-4.20.03.01).
The ADI driver shall verify configuration register A and B are correctly written for each IC (RequirementId: D7.1 V1R0 SIF-4.20.02.01).
The ADI driver shall detect stuck voltage register content to identify measurement failures (RequirementId: D7.1 V1R0 SIF-4.40.01.02).
The ADI driver shall detect stuck auxiliary register content to identify GPIO measurement failures (RequirementId: D7.1 V1R0 SIF-4.40.02.02).
The ADI driver shall support redundant cell voltage measurements using both C-ADC and S-ADC for comparison.
The ADI driver shall support C-ADC vs S-ADC comparison with configurable voltage thresholds from 5.1mV to 45.05mV.
The ADI driver shall support IIR filter with configurable parameters (disabled, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 128, 256).
The ADI driver shall wait 5ms for IIR filter to settle after reset and preload (RequirementId: D7.1 V1R0 SIF-4.10.04.02).
The ADI driver shall perform open-wire detection by activating 470 Ohm pull-up resistors and comparing cell voltages.
The ADI driver shall assert that pointer parameters to state functions are not NULL.
The ADI driver shall assert that voltage store location is within valid range (ADI_VOLTAGE_STORE_LOCATION_E_MAX).
The ADI driver shall read cell voltages from 6 register groups (A through F) containing up to 3 voltages each (RequirementId: D7.1 V1R0 FUN-1.10.01.01).
The ADI driver shall convert raw voltage values using the formula: voltage = (rawValue * 150e-6 * 1000) + 1500 mV.
The ADI driver shall check that voltage register does not contain cleared value (0x8000) to detect measurement validity (RequirementId: D7.1 V1R0 SIF-4.40.01.01).
The ADI driver shall provide diagnostic functions to evaluate cell voltage, GPIO voltage, and module voltage measurements.
The ADI driver shall convert GPIO voltages to temperatures using NTC characteristics and voltage divider lookup table.
The ADI driver shall support configurable PEC (Packet Error Code) handling with option to discard or validate.
The ADI driver shall wait 5ms for reference voltage to stabilize before measurements (ADI_TREFUP_ms).
The ADI driver shall wait 50ms after soft reset before continuing operations (ADI_TSOFTRESET_ms).
The LTC driver shall implement a state machine with states for initialization, measurement, balance control, and error handling.
The LTC driver shall support three ADC measurement modes: Fast, Normal, and Filtered with DCP0 and DCP1 variants.
The LTC driver shall support cell voltage measurements for all channels or specific two-cell pairs.
The LTC driver shall support GPIO voltage measurements for all GPIO channels or individual GPIO1 through GPIO5.
The LTC driver shall implement open-wire detection with pull-up and pull-down current modes.
The LTC driver shall track PEC validity for each IC in the daisy-chain.
The LTC driver shall store open-wire detection data including pull-up, pull-down, and delta measurements per cell.
The LTC driver trigger function shall be called time-triggered every 1ms to advance the state machine.
The LTC driver shall validate state requests before execution and reject invalid requests.
The LTC driver shall support ADC accuracy verification with self-test modes.
The LTC driver shall support digital filter self-test to verify cell voltage, auxiliary, and status register filtering.
The LTC driver shall support I2C communication through the AFE for external EEPROM and temperature sensor access.
The LTC driver shall support multiplexer configuration for temperature measurement using GPIO channels.
The Maxim driver shall implement a hierarchical state machine with main state machine in mxm_1785x.c and sub-state machines for battery management protocol and 17841B ASCI.
The Maxim driver shall execute diagnostic cycles after a configurable threshold of measurement iterations (MXM_THRESHOLD_DIAGNOSTIC_AFTER_CYCLES = 10).
The Maxim driver shall use 5000mV as unipolar full-scale reference value for cell voltage measurements.
The Maxim driver shall execute pre-initialization self-checks including CRC8, conversion, and address space verification tests.
The Maxim driver shall process open-wire detection results and write to the database.
The Maxim driver shall implement error handler reset as a last resort recovery mechanism when error counter threshold is exceeded.
The Maxim driver shall assert that state pointers are not NULL before accessing state machine data.
The Maxim driver shall assert that model ID is valid (not exceeding MXM_MODEL_ID_invalid).
The Maxim driver shall assert that receive buffer length does not exceed MXM_5X_RX_BUFFER_LEN.
The Maxim driver shall assert that number of satellites does not exceed MXM_MAXIMUM_NR_OF_MODULES.
The NXP MC3377x driver shall provide a trigger function (N77x_Measure) to be called time-triggered every 1ms.
The NXP MC3377x driver shall provide a function to check if the first measurement cycle has been completed.
The NXP MC33775A driver shall support a maximum of 14 cell measurements per IC.
The TI AFE driver shall provide a Measure function to trigger AFE measurements.
The TI AFE driver shall provide an Initialize function to set up the analog front-end.
The TI AFE driver shall provide functions for EEPROM read/write, temperature read, balancing feedback read, and open-wire check requests per string.
The TI AFE driver shall provide a function to check if the first measurement cycle has been completed.
The Temperature Sensor Interface shall translate an ADC voltage in mV to a temperature value in deci degrees Celsius according to the chosen temperature sensor implementation
The Temperature Sensor Interface shall provide a function to return the maximum plausible temperature that can be returned from the TSI in deci degrees Celsius
The Temperature Sensor Interface shall provide a function to return the minimum plausible temperature that can be returned from the TSI in deci degrees Celsius
The TSI header shall expose only the TSI_GetTemperature function as the public interface
Temperature sensor lookup table entries shall store temperature in deci degrees Celsius (int16_t) and resistance in Ohms (float_t)
Voltage conversion shall use a scaling factor of 1000.0f to convert between volts and millivolts
The Beta temperature calculation module shall convert measured ADC voltage in mV to temperature in deci degrees Celsius using the Beta (Steinhart-Hart) formula
The Beta calculation shall return FLT_MAX or FLT_MIN when the NTC is shorted or disconnected, and the caller shall check for these return values to prevent invalid data
The Beta module shall support configurable NTC position in resistor divider (R_1 or R_2 position) via BETA_POSITION_IN_RESISTOR_DIVIDER_IS_R_1 parameter
The Beta module shall use a configurable resistor divider supply voltage, default 4.096V
The Beta module shall use a configurable reference resistor value in the divider, default 10000.0 Ohm
The Beta module shall use a reference temperature of 25.0 degrees Celsius for NTC calculations
The Beta module shall use a configurable NTC resistance at reference temperature, default 10000.0 Ohm
The Beta module shall use a configurable Beta coefficient for the NTC, default 3984.0
The Beta temperature calculation shall use the Kelvin offset constant of 273.15 for temperature conversion
When ADC voltage exceeds the maximum valid range, the Beta module shall return INT16_MIN indicating sensor disconnection or short circuit
When ADC voltage is below the minimum valid range, the Beta module shall return INT16_MAX indicating sensor out of operating range
When calculated NTC resistance is zero or negative, the Beta module shall return INT16_MIN as an invalid temperature indicator
The Beta module shall provide a function to calculate NTC resistance from a given temperature for computing Vmin and Vmax of the divider
The EPCOS B57251V5103J060 temperature sensor driver shall convert ADC voltage in mV to temperature in deci degrees Celsius using lookup table interpolation
The EPCOS B57251V5103J060 driver shall return INT16_MAX or INT16_MIN when NTC is shorted or disconnected, and the caller shall check for these return values
The EPCOS B57251V5103J060 driver shall provide polynomial-based temperature calculation as an alternative to lookup table
The EPCOS B57251V5103J060 NTC position in resistor divider shall be configurable, default is R_2 (below voltage tap)
The EPCOS B57251V5103J060 resistor divider shall use a supply voltage of 2.5V
The EPCOS B57251V5103J060 resistor divider shall use a reference resistor value of 10000.0 Ohm
The EPCOS B57251V5103J060 lookup table shall cover a temperature range from -55.0 to +150.0 degrees Celsius with 5-degree resolution
The EPCOS B57251V5103J060 lookup table shall be ordered from higher resistance (low temperature) to lower resistance (high temperature)
The EPCOS B57251V5103J060 driver shall use linear interpolation between LUT values but shall not extrapolate beyond LUT boundaries
The EPCOS B57251V5103J060 polynomial calculation shall use a 6th degree polynomial approximation
The EPCOS B57861S0103F045 temperature sensor driver shall convert ADC voltage in mV to temperature in deci degrees Celsius using lookup table interpolation
The EPCOS B57861S0103F045 driver shall return INT16_MAX or INT16_MIN when NTC is shorted or disconnected
The EPCOS B57861S0103F045 resistor divider shall use a supply voltage of 3.0V
The EPCOS B57861S0103F045 lookup table shall cover a temperature range from -55.0 to +155.0 degrees Celsius
The EPCOS B57861S0103F045 polynomial calculation shall use a 5th degree polynomial approximation for Vref=3V and 10k series resistor
The Murata NCxxxxH103 temperature sensor driver shall convert ADC voltage in mV to temperature in deci degrees Celsius using lookup table interpolation
The Murata NCxxxxH103 driver shall return INT16_MAX or INT16_MIN when NTC is shorted or disconnected
The Murata NCxxxxH103 resistor divider shall use a supply voltage of 3.3V
The Murata NCxxxxH103 lookup table shall cover a temperature range from -40.0 to +150.0 degrees Celsius with 5-degree resolution
The Murata NCxxxxH103 polynomial function shall trigger FAS_ASSERT trap as it is not yet implemented
The Vishay NTCALUG01A103G temperature sensor driver shall convert ADC voltage in mV to temperature in deci degrees Celsius using lookup table interpolation
The Vishay NTCALUG01A103G driver shall return INT16_MAX or INT16_MIN when NTC is shorted or disconnected
The Vishay NTCALUG01A103G resistor divider shall use a supply voltage of 3.0V
The Vishay NTCALUG01A103G lookup table shall cover a temperature range from -40.0 to +105.0 degrees Celsius with 1-degree resolution
The Vishay NTCALUG01A103G polynomial function shall trigger FAS_ASSERT trap as it is not yet implemented
The Vishay NTCLE317E4103SBA temperature sensor driver shall convert ADC voltage in mV to temperature in deci degrees Celsius using lookup table interpolation
The Vishay NTCLE317E4103SBA driver shall return INT16_MAX or INT16_MIN when NTC is shorted or disconnected
The Vishay NTCLE317E4103SBA resistor divider shall use a supply voltage of 3.0V
The Vishay NTCLE317E4103SBA lookup table shall cover a temperature range from -55.0 to +150.0 degrees Celsius with 1-degree resolution
The Vishay NTCLE317E4103SBA polynomial function shall trigger FAS_ASSERT trap as it is not yet implemented
The Vishay NTCLE413E2103F102L temperature sensor driver shall convert ADC voltage in mV to temperature in deci degrees Celsius using lookup table interpolation
The Vishay NTCLE413E2103F102L driver shall return INT16_MAX or INT16_MIN when NTC is shorted or disconnected
The Vishay NTCLE413E2103F102L resistor divider shall use a supply voltage of 3.0V
The Vishay NTCLE413E2103F102L lookup table shall cover a temperature range from -40 to +105 degrees Celsius with 5-degree resolution
The Vishay NTCLE413E2103F102L polynomial function shall trigger FAS_ASSERT trap as it is not yet implemented
The TDK NTCG163JX103DT1S temperature sensor driver shall convert ADC voltage in mV to temperature in deci degrees Celsius using lookup table interpolation
The TDK NTCG163JX103DT1S driver shall return INT16_MAX or INT16_MIN when NTC is shorted or disconnected
The TDK NTCG163JX103DT1S resistor divider shall use a supply voltage of 2.5V
The TDK NTCG163JX103DT1S lookup table shall cover a temperature range from -40.0 to +150.0 degrees Celsius with 5-degree resolution
The TDK NTCG163JX103DT1S polynomial function shall trigger FAS_ASSERT trap as it is not yet implemented
The Semitec 103JT temperature sensor driver shall convert ADC voltage in mV to temperature in deci degrees Celsius using lookup table interpolation
The Semitec 103JT driver shall return INT16_MAX or INT16_MIN when NTC is shorted or disconnected
The Semitec 103JT resistor divider shall use a supply voltage of 2.5V
The Semitec 103JT lookup table shall cover a temperature range from -50.0 to +90.0 degrees Celsius with 10-degree resolution
The Semitec 103JT polynomial function shall trigger FAS_ASSERT trap as it is not yet implemented
The fake temperature sensor driver shall return the ADC voltage value directly as a fake temperature for testing purposes
The fake temperature sensor lookup table function shall return the input ADC voltage cast to int16_t
The fake temperature sensor polynomial function shall return the input ADC voltage cast to int16_t
All temperature sensor drivers shall use a consistent resistor divider calculation formula: R_2 = R_1 * (V_adc / (V_supply - V_adc)) when NTC is in R_2 position
All temperature sensor drivers shall use a consistent resistor divider calculation formula: R_1 = R_2 * ((V_supply / V_adc) - 1) when NTC is in R_1 position
All temperature sensor drivers shall use MATH_LinearInterpolation function for interpolation between LUT values
All temperature sensor drivers shall validate ADC voltage against minimum and maximum bounds before calculation
All temperature sensor drivers shall return INT16_MIN when measured ADC voltage exceeds maximum valid range indicating sensor disconnection or open circuit
All temperature sensor drivers shall return INT16_MAX when measured ADC voltage is below minimum valid range indicating sensor short circuit
All temperature sensor drivers shall use a reference resistor value of 10000.0 Ohm in the voltage divider
All NTC temperature sensors shall have a nominal resistance of 10000 Ohm at 25 degrees Celsius (10k NTC thermistors)
Temperature sensor lookup tables shall not extrapolate beyond the defined temperature range boundaries
Temperature values shall be expressed in deci degrees Celsius (multiply by 10) for integer representation with 0.1 degree resolution
Temperature sensor implementations shall be selectable at compile time by linking the appropriate lookup-table or polynomial source file
Each sensor type shall provide both lookup table and polynomial implementations of the TSI_GetTemperature function
Lookup tables shall be organized from higher resistance (lower temperature) to lower resistance (higher temperature)
Lookup table size shall be computed at compile time using sizeof operator to avoid hardcoded array sizes
Lookup table interpolation shall find two adjacent entries that bracket the measured resistance value

The battery cell maximum temperature during discharge shall be limited to 55.0 degC (MSL), 50.0 degC (RSL), and 45.0 degC (MOL). When MSL is violated, error state is requested and contactors will open.

The battery cell minimum temperature during discharge shall be limited to -20.0 degC (MSL), -15.0 degC (RSL), and -10.0 degC (MOL). When MSL is violated, error state is requested and contactors will open.
The battery cell maximum temperature during charge shall be limited to 45.0 degC (MSL), 40.0 degC (RSL), and 35.0 degC (MOL). When MSL is violated, error state is requested and contactors will open.

The battery cell minimum temperature during charge shall be limited to -20.0 degC (MSL), -15.0 degC (RSL), and -10.0 degC (MOL). When MSL is violated, error state is requested and contactors will open.
The maximum cell voltage shall be limited to 2800 mV (MSL), 2750 mV (RSL), and 2720 mV (MOL). When MSL is violated, error state is requested and contactors will open.
The nominal cell voltage according to data sheet shall be configured as 2500 mV.
The minimum cell voltage shall be limited to 1500 mV (MSL), 1550 mV (RSL), and 1580 mV (MOL). When MSL is violated, error state is requested and contactors will open.

The deep-discharge cell voltage limit shall be set equal to the minimum voltage MSL. If this limit is violated, the cell is considered faulty and the BMS will not allow closing of contactors until the cell is replaced.
The maximum discharge current shall be limited to 180000 mA (MSL), 175000 mA (RSL), and 170000 mA (MOL). When MSL is violated, error state is requested and contactors will open.
The maximum charge current shall be limited to 180000 mA (MSL), 175000 mA (RSL), and 170000 mA (MOL). When MSL is violated, error state is requested and contactors will open.
The cell capacity used for SOC calculation shall be configured as 3500 mAh.
The cell energy shall be configured as 10.0 Wh.
A static assertion shall verify that the minimum voltage MSL is not lower than the deep-discharge limit.
The number of parallel strings in the battery pack shall be configurable, with a default value of 1.
The number of modules per string shall be configurable, with a default value of 1.
The number of cell blocks per module shall be configurable, with a default value of 18. Parallel cells are counted as one cell block.
The number of parallel cells per cell block shall be configurable, with a default value of 1.
The number of temperature sensors per battery module shall be configurable, with a default value of 8.
The number of temperature inputs shall not exceed the number of GPIOs per module.
The current sensor presence shall be configurable. If set to true, foxBMS checks for the presence of a current sensor and raises an error if sensor stops responding during runtime.
The current measurement response timeout shall be configured as 200 ms. After this delay, it is considered that the current measurement is not responding.
The coulomb counting measurement response timeout shall be configured as 2000 ms.
The energy counting measurement response timeout shall be configured as 2000 ms.
The maximum break current of main contactors shall be configured as 3500 mA. Contactors will not be opened if the floating current is above this value to prevent contact welding.
The maximum fuse trigger duration shall be configured as 3000 ms. If current exceeds maximum break current, the BMS will wait this time for the fuse to trigger before attempting to open contactors.
The maximum string current limit for SOA module shall be configured as 2400 mA. When MSL is violated, error state is requested and contactors will open.
The maximum pack current limit for SOA module shall be calculated as 2400 mA multiplied by the number of strings. When MSL is violated, error state is requested and contactors will open.
The interlock feedback evaluation shall be configurable. When set to false, interlock feedback will be evaluated; when set to true, it will be discarded.
CAN timing check shall be configurable. When set to true, foxBMS checks CAN timing and requires a valid request every 100ms within the 95-105ms window.
Balancing default state shall be configurable. When set to true, balancing is deactivated completely; when set to false, foxBMS activates balancing when needed.
The number of high voltage inputs measured by current sensors shall be configured as 3.
The current threshold for determining rest state of battery shall be configured as 200 mA. If absolute current is below this limit, the battery is considered at rest.
The relaxation period before battery system is at rest shall be configured as 60000 (in units of 10ms, i.e., 600 seconds). Balancing only starts if battery system is at rest.
The current sensor threshold for zero current detection shall be configured as 200 mA to account for sensor jitter.
The maximum voltage drop over fuse shall be configured as 500 mV. If measured voltage difference exceeds this value, it indicates the fuse has tripped.
Open-wire check during standby mode shall be configurable, with default state disabled.
Periodic open-wire check time in STANDBY state shall be configured as 600000 ms (10 minutes).
Periodic open-wire check time in ERROR state shall be configured as 30000 ms (30 seconds).
The BMS state machine task cycle time shall be configured as 10 ms.
BMS state machine short time shall be configured as 1 trigger call (10ms with default task cycle).
BMS state machine medium time shall be configured as 5 trigger calls (50ms with default task cycle).
BMS state machine long time shall be configured as 10 trigger calls (100ms with default task cycle).
Wait time after closing any string contactor shall be configured as 20 trigger calls (200ms).
Wait time after opening any string contactor shall be configured as 10 trigger calls (100ms).
Wait time between closing complete strings shall be configured as 10 trigger calls (100ms).
String close timeout shall be configured as 500 trigger calls (5 seconds). State machine goes to error if string has not closed within this time.
String open timeout shall be configured as 1000 trigger calls (10 seconds). State machine goes to error if string has not opened within this time.
Maximum voltage difference between two strings to allow closing the next string shall be configured as 3000 mV.
Maximum average string current to allow closing next string shall be configured as 20000 mA.
Delay after closing precharge shall be configured as 200 trigger calls (2 seconds).
Delay after opening precharge shall be configured as 50 trigger calls (500ms).
Oscillation timeout shall be configured as 1000 (in 10ms units, i.e., 10 seconds) to prevent mechanical close/open timer cycle in case of incorrect state requests.
Number of allowed precharge tries shall be configured as 3.
Precharge voltage threshold shall be configured as 1000 mV.
Precharge current threshold shall be configured as 50 mA.
Precharge close timeout shall be configured as 500 trigger calls (5 seconds). State machine goes to error if precharge has not closed within this time.
Precharge open timeout shall be configured as 500 trigger calls (5 seconds). State machine goes to error if precharge has not opened within this time.
Balancing state machine short time shall be configured as 1 (in 100ms units, i.e., 100ms).
Balancing state machine long time shall be configured as 50 (in 100ms units, i.e., 5 seconds).
Balancing time per cycle shall be configured as 10 (in 100ms units, i.e., 1 second).
Default balancing voltage threshold shall be configured as 200 mV.
Maximum balancing voltage threshold shall be limited to 5000 mV.
Minimum balancing voltage threshold shall be 0 mV.
Balancing hysteresis for voltage threshold when balancing was finished shall be configured as 200 mV.
Balancing lower voltage limit shall be configured as 2000 mV. Cells below this voltage shall not be balanced.
Balancing upper temperature limit shall be configured as 700 deci degC (70.0 degC). Balancing shall not occur above this temperature.
Maximum difference between pack voltage measurement from AFE and current sensor shall be configured as 3000 mV. Range: [0, 10000].
Maximum difference between redundant cell voltage measurement shall be configured as 10 mV. Range: [0, 10000].
Maximum difference between redundant cell temperature measurements shall be configured as 50 deci kelvin (5.0 K). Range: [0, 100].
Maximum deviation between a single cell voltage measurement and the average cell voltage shall be configured as 300 mV. Range: [0, 10000].
Maximum deviation between a single cell temperature measurement and the average cell temperature shall be configured as 100 deci kelvin (10.0 K). Range: [0, 100].
Number of GPIOs per BMS-Slave module shall be configured as 10.
Number of GPA inputs per BMS-Slave module shall be configured as 2.
Value of the balancing resistors on the BMS-Slave board shall be configured as 100.0 ohm.
Value of the input capacitors between cell inputs on BMS-Slave board shall be configurable, with default value of 0 nF (no capacitors).
Number of SPI interfaces shall be configured as 5.
SPI TX buffer empty timeout shall be configured as 6000 iterations to avoid infinite loop.
Maximum number of hardware chip select pins shall be configured as 6.
SBC MCU chip select pin shall be configured as pin 0.
Maximum CAN ID for 11-bit identifier shall be 2048.
Maximum CAN Data Length Code shall be 8 bytes.
Default CAN DLC for foxBMS messages shall be 8 bytes.
Number of cell voltages received per CAN message shall be 4.
Number of cell temperatures received per CAN message shall be 6.
Number of SPS IC outputs per IC shall be 4 (each SPS IC has four outputs).
Number of SPS ICs in the daisy-chain shall be configured as 2.
LSB of SPS current measurement shall be 0.98 mA.
Current threshold that recognizes a contactor as closed shall be configured as 20.0 mA.
Number of required SPS contactor channels shall equal the number of contactors in the system.
A static assertion shall verify that the number of required contactor channels does not exceed available SPS channels.
Interlock high-side voltage sense signal shall be connected to ADC input 2.
Interlock low-side voltage sense signal shall be connected to ADC input 3.
Interlock high-side current sense signal shall be connected to ADC input 4.
Interlock low-side current sense signal shall be connected to ADC input 5.
Interlock voltage divider factor shall be calculated as (5.6 + 3.9) / 3.9 based on resistor values of 5k6 ohm and 3k9 ohm.
Interlock state machine short time shall be configured as 1 trigger call.
Number of port expanders shall be configured as 3.
Number of SPI interfaces for DMA shall be configured as 5.
Minimum operating range temperature for cell temperature measurements shall be -50.0 degC (-500 deci degC). Range: [-150, 0].
Maximum operating range temperature for cell temperature measurements shall be 125.0 degC (1250 deci degC). Range: [80, 250].
The SBC module shall provide a state machine with the following states: UNINITIALIZED, INITIALIZATION, RUNNING, and ERROR.
requirements.rationale: State machine enumeration SBC_STATEMACHINE_e defines core operational states for SBC control

requirements.content: The SBC state machine trigger function shall be called time-triggered every 10ms.
requirements.rationale: SBC_STATEMACHINE_TASK_CYCLE_CONTEXT_MS define and compile-time assertion enforce 10ms cycle time

requirements.content: The SBC trigger function shall implement re-entrance protection to prevent concurrent execution.
requirements.rationale: SBC_CheckReEntrance function ensures state machine is not re-entered during execution

requirements.content: Re-entrance check shall use OS critical section to atomically increment triggerEntry counter.
requirements.rationale: OS_EnterTaskCritical/OS_ExitTaskCritical used to protect triggerEntry counter access

requirements.content: The SBC instance pointer parameter shall be validated as non-NULL before processing.
requirements.rationale: FAS_ASSERT(pInstance != NULL_PTR) present at entry of all functions accepting SBC_STATE_s pointer

requirements.content: The SBC initialization request shall only be accepted when the state machine is in UNINITIALIZED state.
requirements.rationale: SBC_CheckStateRequest validates INIT_REQUEST only allowed from UNINITIALIZED state

requirements.content: The SBC shall return SBC_ALREADY_INITIALIZED if initialization is requested when already initialized.
requirements.rationale: Return type enumeration includes SBC_ALREADY_INITIALIZED for duplicate init requests

requirements.content: The SBC state request function shall use OS critical section to atomically update state request.
requirements.rationale: SBC_SetStateRequest uses OS_EnterTaskCritical/OS_ExitTaskCritical for atomic request update

requirements.content: The SBC shall count and track illegal state requests.
requirements.rationale: illegalRequestsCounter incremented when invalid request is pending

requirements.content: The SBC initialization shall transition to ERROR state if FS85 initialization fails after maximum retry count (3 retries).
requirements.rationale: Retry counter check with maximum of 3 retries before transitioning to ERROR state

requirements.content: The SBC watchdog shall be triggered periodically when in PERIODIC_WATCHDOG_ACTIVATED state.
requirements.rationale: SBC_TriggerWatchdogIfRequired called when watchdogState equals SBC_PERIODIC_WATCHDOG_ACTIVATED

requirements.content: The SBC watchdog trigger period shall be configurable with default period of 100ms.
requirements.rationale: SBC_WINDOW_WATCHDOG_PERIOD_MS defined as 100ms default watchdog period

requirements.content: The SBC watchdog counter shall be decremented each trigger cycle and watchdog refreshed when counter reaches zero.
requirements.rationale: SBC_TriggerWatchdogIfRequired decrements watchdogTrigger and calls FS85_TriggerWatchdog when zero

requirements.content: The SBC shall transition to RUNNING state after successful initialization including safety path checks.
requirements.rationale: State transition to RUNNING after SBC_INITIALIZE_SAFETY_PATH_CHECK substate completes successfully

requirements.content: The SBC state machine shall trap on invalid state in default case.
requirements.rationale: FAS_ASSERT(FAS_TRAP) in default case ensures invalid states cause assertion failure

requirements.content: The SBC state machine shall trap on invalid substate during initialization.
requirements.rationale: FAS_ASSERT(FAS_TRAP) in else branch of initialization substates catches invalid substates

requirements.content: The FS85 initialization shall verify LBIST (logical built-in self-test) and ABIST1 (analog built-in self-test) pass status.
requirements.rationale: FS85_InitializeFsPhase verifies FS8X_FS_LBIST_OK_PASS and FS8X_FS_ABIST1_OK_PASS

requirements.content: The FS85 initialization shall detect and report if debug mode is active.
requirements.rationale: Debug mode check sets FS85_DEBUG_MODE and reports via MINFO_SetDebugProbeConnectionState

requirements.content: The FS85 initialization shall verify no OTP CRC error exists.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_OTP_CORRUPT_NO_ERROR check ensures OTP memory integrity

requirements.content: The FS85 shall be configured to enter FS_INIT state if not already in that state.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_GO_TO_INITFS_GO_BACK_TO_INIT_FS written to transition SBC to FS_INIT state

requirements.content: The FS85 fail-safe registers shall be written using both DATA and DATA_NOT (inverted) for corruption detection.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_WriteRegisterInit writes to FS_I_Register and FS_I_NOT_Register with inverted data

requirements.content: The FS85 watchdog window period shall be configured to 128ms.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_WD_WINDOW_128MS configured in watchdog window register

requirements.content: The FS85 watchdog window duty cycle shall be configured to 50%.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_WDW_DC_50 configured for 50% duty cycle

requirements.content: The FS85 watchdog fault recovery shall be configured to 128ms.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_WDW_RECOVERY_128MS configured for watchdog recovery

requirements.content: The FS85 fault error counter limit shall be configured to 8.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_I_FLT_ERR_CNT_LIMIT_8 configured as maximum fault error count

requirements.content: The FS85 fault error counter reaching limit shall impact both FS0B and RSTB pins.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_I_FLT_ERR_IMPACT_FS0B_RSTB configured to assert both safety outputs on fault

requirements.content: The FS85 RSTB pulse duration shall be configured to 10ms.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_I_RSTB_DUR_10MS configured for reset pulse width

requirements.content: The FS85 initialization shall close INIT_FS phase by sending the first good watchdog refresh.
requirements.rationale: FS85_TriggerWatchdog called to close INIT_FS phase after configuration

requirements.content: The FS85 shall execute ABIST2 after closing INIT_FS and verify it passes within 1.2ms.
requirements.rationale: MCU_Delay_us(1200u) wait followed by FS8X_FS_ABIST2_OK_MASK verification

requirements.content: The FS85 shall clear all diagnostic flags in FS_DIAG_SAFETY register after ABIST2.
requirements.rationale: FS85_ClearRegisterFlags called to clear FCCU, ERRMON, WD, SPI, I2C error flags

requirements.content: The FS85 shall clear all voltage monitoring flags in FS_OVUVREG_STATUS register.
requirements.rationale: All VMON, VCOREMON, VDDIO OV/UV flags cleared in overvoltage/undervoltage status register

requirements.content: The fault error counter shall be cleared to zero by consecutive good watchdog refreshes before safety path check.
requirements.rationale: FS85_InitializeNumberOfRequiredWatchdogRefreshes calculates required refreshes to clear counter

requirements.content: The FS85 watchdog refresh counter limit options shall be 1, 2, 4, or 6 refreshes.
requirements.rationale: Watchdog refresh limit enumeration values 1, 2, 4, 6 checked in configuration

requirements.content: The FS85 shall perform RSTB safety path check to verify external reset path functionality.
requirements.rationale: FS85_PerformPathCheckRstb verifies RSTB pin can bring safety outputs to known levels

requirements.content: The FS85 shall perform FS0B safety path check to verify fail-safe output functionality.
requirements.rationale: FS85_PerformPathCheckFs0b verifies FS0B pin can bring safety outputs to known levels

requirements.content: The FS85 FS0B pin shall only be released when not in debug mode.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_FS0B_Release only called when pInstance->mode != FS85_DEBUG_MODE

requirements.content: The FS85 FS0B release shall require fault error counter equals zero and LBIST/ABIST1/ABIST2 pass as preconditions.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_FS0B_Release checks errorCounter == 0 and all BIST pass flags before release

requirements.content: The FS85 FS0B release value shall be computed as reversed and complemented watchdog seed.
requirements.rationale: Bit reversal and complement of WD_SEED required for FS0B release authentication

requirements.content: The FS85 initialization state shall be persisted to NVRAM for power-cycle recovery.
requirements.rationale: FRAM_WriteData called to persist FS85_INITIALIZED phase to non-volatile memory

requirements.content: The FS85 shall detect short-circuit between FIN and RSTB pins during power-on reset.
requirements.rationale: FIN pin toggled low for 10us to detect short-circuit with RSTB; reset indicates short

requirements.content: The FS85 FIN state shall be persisted to NVRAM and reported via diagnostic handler.
requirements.rationale: DIAG_Handler and FRAM update for FIN state after short-circuit test

requirements.content: The FS85 shall verify RSTB assertion test by checking RSTB_EVENT flag after external reset.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_RSTB_EVENT_RESET_OCCURRED check verifies RSTB assertion test succeeded

requirements.content: The SBC watchdog trigger shall verify good watchdog refresh by checking GRL_FLAGS register.
requirements.rationale: FS8X_FS_FS_WD_G_GOOD_WD_REFRESH checked after watchdog refresh

requirements.content: The SBC watchdog shall diagnose bad watchdog refresh timing or data errors.
requirements.rationale: BAD_WD_TIMING and BAD_WD_DATA flags checked on watchdog refresh failure

requirements.content: The SBC shall monitor ignition signal (WAKE1) and transition to standby mode on falling edge.
requirements.rationale: FS85_CheckIgnitionSignal monitors WAKE1 and calls FS85_GoToStandby on falling edge

requirements.content: The ignition signal monitoring shall be configurable via useIgnitionForPowerDown flag.
requirements.rationale: useIgnitionForPowerDown configuration flag controls ignition signal monitoring

requirements.content: The FS85 SPI communication shall use CRC8 with polynomial 0x1D for data integrity.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_COM_CRC_POLYNOM = 0x1D and FS8x_COM_CRC_INIT = 0xFF for CRC calculation

requirements.content: The FS85 SPI communication frame shall be 4 bytes with format: CRC, Data LSB, Data MSB, Address/Command.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_COMM_FRAME_SIZE = 4 bytes defines SPI frame length

requirements.content: The FS85 SPI communication shall validate received CRC and return error on mismatch.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_CheckCRC called on received frame with error returned on mismatch

requirements.content: The FS85 register write during INIT_FS shall write to both register and NOT register addresses.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_WriteRegisterInit writes DATA to address and ~DATA to address+1

requirements.content: The FS85 simple watchdog mode shall use configured seed value for refresh.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_WD_TYPE = FS8x_WD_SIMPLE uses drvData->watchdogSeed for refresh

requirements.content: The FS85 default watchdog seed value shall be 0x5AB2.
requirements.rationale: FS8x_WD_SEED_DEFAULT = 0x5AB2 defined as default watchdog seed

requirements.content: The ADC module shall provide a driver for analog-to-digital conversion measurements on the TMS570LC4357 MCU
The ADC module shall implement a state machine with three states: ADC_START_CONVERSION, ADC_WAIT_CONVERSION_FINISHED, and ADC_CONVERSION_FINISHED
The ADC_Control function shall control the ADC measurement sequence
The ADC shall use voltage reference high of 5000mV (ADC_VREFHIGH_mV)
The ADC shall use voltage reference low of 0mV (ADC_VREFLOW_mV)
The ADC shall support 12-bit conversion with a conversion factor of 4096
The ADC state machine shall trap on invalid state (FAS_ASSERT safety mechanism)
The SPI module shall provide headers for the driver for the SPI communication interface
The SPI_Initialize function shall initialize the SPI module using HAL functions and configure chip select setup for peripherals
The SPI_TransmitDummyByte function shall send a dummy byte to wake up the SPI interface
The SPI_TransmitData function shall transmit data on SPI without DMA in blocking mode with automatic chip select handling
The SPI_TransmitReceiveData function shall transmit and receive data on SPI without DMA in blocking mode with automatic chip select handling
The SPI_TransmitReceiveDataDma function shall transmit and receive data on SPI with DMA in blocking mode with automatic chip select handling
The SPI_Lock function shall lock SPI interfaces to prevent concurrent access
The SPI module shall support 5 SPI interfaces (SPI_NR_SPI_INTERFACES = 5)
SPI chip select shall support hardware and software modes (SPI_CHIP_SELECT_HARDWARE, SPI_CHIP_SELECT_SOFTWARE)
The SPI shall validate pSpiInterface is not NULL_PTR before transmission
The SPI shall validate pTxBuff is not NULL_PTR before transmission
The SPI shall validate frameLength is greater than 0 before transmission
The SPI shall validate string parameter is less than BS_NR_OF_STRINGS
The I2C module shall provide header for the driver for the I2C communication interface
The I2C_Initialize function shall initialize the I2C hardware with dedicated HAL functions before any other I2C API call
The I2C_Read function shall read from an I2C slave in blocking mode without writing register address first
The I2C_Write function shall write to an I2C slave in blocking mode without writing register address first
The I2C_ReadDma function shall read from an I2C slave using DMA
The I2C_WriteDma function shall write to an I2C slave using DMA
The I2C module shall use a timeout of 1000 microseconds to avoid infinite loops (I2C_TIMEOUT_us)
The I2C module shall use 2ms notification timeout for DMA transactions (I2C_NOTIFICATION_TIMEOUT_ms)
The DMA module shall provide headers for the driver for the DMA (Direct Memory Access) module
The DMA_Initialize function shall enable the DMA module and DMA streams
The DMA_IsTransmitOngoing function shall return true if SPI transmission is still ongoing, false otherwise
The DMA shall support 5 SPI interfaces for DMA (DMA_NUMBER_SPI_INTERFACES = 5)
The DMA shall map SPI1 TX to DMA_CH0 and SPI1 RX to DMA_CH1
The DMA shall support I2C1 and I2C2 channels (DMA_CH10-DMA_CH13)
The PWM module shall provide a PWM driver for the TMS570LC43xx using the ePWM hardware
The PWM_Initialize function shall initialize the ETPWM and the ECAP module
The PWM_StartPwm function shall start all configured ePWM channels after etpwmInit() is called
The PWM_StopPwm function shall stop all configured ePWM channels
The PWM_SetDutyCycle function shall set duty cycle in permill with out-of-range values limited to threshold values
The PWM_GetPwmData function shall return duty cycle and frequency of input PWM signal
The RTC module shall provide a driver for the NXP PCF2131 Real Time Clock over I2C
The RTC shall use I2C interface i2cREG1 with I2C address 0x53
The RTC_GetSystemTimeRtcFormat function shall return the RTC system timer value
The RTC_IncrementSystemTime function shall be called every millisecond from the 1ms task
The RTC_Initialize function shall return STD_OK when initialization is finished, STD_NOT_OK otherwise

The RTC shall implement initialization states: RTC_SET_SYSTEM_TIMER, RTC_SET_BATTERY_LOW_FLAG, RTC_CLEAR_OTPR, RTC_WAIT_CLEAR_OTPR, RTC_OTPR_CLEARED, RTC_SET_OTPR, RTC_WAIT_SET_OTPR, RTC_INIT_SET_FINISHED
The RTC shall allow maximum 1 second difference between RTC timer and IC time (RTC_MAX_DIFFERENCE_BETWEEN_TIMER_AND_IC_s)
The IO module shall provide a driver for the IO (Input/Output) control
The IO_SetPinDirectionToOutput function shall configure a pin as output by writing to the pin direction register
The IO_SetPinDirectionToInput function shall configure a pin as input by writing to the pin direction register
The IO_PinSet function shall set a pin high by writing to the pin output register
The IO_PinReset function shall set a pin low by writing to the pin output register
The IO_PinGet function shall return the state of a pin (STD_PIN_STATE_e)
The IO module shall validate pRegisterAddress is not NULL_PTR before operations
The IO module shall validate pin number is within MCU_LARGEST_PIN_NUMBER (31)
The LED module shall provide a debug LED driver that is directly connected to an MCU pin to indicate basic operation states
The LED shall indicate normal operation with 500ms on/off time (slow blinking pattern)
The LED shall indicate error state with 100ms on/off time (fast blinking pattern)
The LED_SetDebugLed function shall turn on the debug LED during startup before LED_SetToggleTime is called
The LED_Trigger function shall periodically toggle the debug LED at the frequency set by LED_SetToggleTime
The MCU module shall provide headers for the driver for the MCU (microcontroller) module
The MCU shall support a largest pin number of 31 for TMS570LC4357
The MCU ADC1 shall support maximum 32 channels
The MCU_Delay_us function shall provide blocking delay in microseconds using Free Running Counter 0 (FRC0)
The MCU_GetFreeRunningCount function shall return the current value of the Free Running Counter 0 (FRC0)
The MCU_IsTimeElapsed function shall check if a timeout in microseconds has elapsed since a given starting counter value
The interlock module shall provide a driver for the interlock circuit measuring relevant hardware signals
The interlock state machine shall have states: ILCK_STATEMACHINE_UNINITIALIZED, ILCK_STATEMACHINE_INITIALIZED, ILCK_STATEMACHINE_UNDEFINED
The ILCK_SetStateRequest function shall validate state requests and return result immediately
The ILCK_Trigger function shall be called time-triggered every 1ms
The interlock shall use diagnostic supply enable pin at position 30 (ILCK_INTERLOCK_CONTROL_PIN_IL_HS_ENABLE)
The interlock shall use feedback pin at position 29 (ILCK_INTERLOCK_FEEDBACK_PIN_IL_STATE)
The interlock shall use voltage divider factor of (5.6 + 3.9) / 3.9 for measuring interlock voltages
The interlock state machine shall trap on undefined state (FAS_ASSERT safety mechanism)
The interlock shall report feedback status to diagnostic handler (DIAG_ID_INTERLOCK_FEEDBACK)
The FRAM module shall provide a driver for FRAM (Ferroelectric RAM) non-volatile memory
The FRAM_Initialize function shall initialize addresses to be written in FRAM before any use
The FRAM_WriteData function shall write a variable to FRAM corresponding to the block ID
The FRAM_ReadData function shall read a variable from FRAM corresponding to the block ID
The FRAM shall return FRAM_ACCESS_OK, FRAM_ACCESS_SPI_BUSY, FRAM_ACCESS_CRC_BUSY, or FRAM_ACCESS_CRC_ERROR status
The FRAM shall store VERSION, SOC, SBC_INIT_STATE, DEEP_DISCHARGE_FLAG, SOE, SYS_MON_RECORD, and INSULATION_FLAG blocks
The FRAM shall use 8-byte CRC header for data integrity (FRAM_CRC_HEADER_SIZE)
The foxmath module shall provide math library for often used math functions including slope and linear interpolation
The MATH_StartupSelfTest function shall provide self-test for math functions that can be called at startup
The MATH_LinearInterpolation function shall linearly inter-/extrapolate a third point according to two given points
The MATH_AbsInt32_t function shall return absolute value or INT32_MAX if INT32_MIN is passed
The checksum module shall provide checksum validation functionality
The CHK_ValidateChecksum function shall validate checksum and return STD_RETURN_TYPE_e
The CRC module shall use the system CRC hardware for data integrity calculation
The CRC shall use seed value 0xBADC0DED (high) and 0xDEADBEEF (low) for CRC calculation
The CRC_CalculateCrc function shall compute CRC of data flow using MCU hardware with byte chunks
The PEX module shall provide a driver for the NXP PCA9539 port expander module
The PEX shall support 3 port expanders (PEX_NR_OF_PORT_EXPANDERS = 3)
The PEX_Initialize function shall initialize local variable containing state of port expander
The PEX_SetPin function shall set a port expander pin to high
The PEX_ResetPin function shall set a port expander pin to low
The PEX_Trigger function shall implement reading/writing to port expander registers via I2C
The PHY module shall provide configuration for the PHY layer including address and timing settings
The PHY shall use address 1 (PHY_ADDRESS)
The PHY shall require at least 720ns for hardware reset (PHY_HW_RESET_TIME = 1)
The PHY auto-negotiation delay shall be 100 time units (PHY_AUTO_NEG_DELAY_TIME)
The MEAS module shall provide driver for measurements needed by the BMS (current, voltage, temperature)
The MEAS_Initialize function shall call all initialization functions
The MEAS_Control function shall be called from the task every 1ms
The MEAS_IsFirstMeasurementCycleFinished function shall check if the first AFE measurement cycle was completed
The MEAS_RequestOpenWireCheck function shall make request to AFE state machine to perform open-wire check
The HTSEN module shall provide a driver for the Sensirion SHT35-DIS I2C humidity/temperature sensor
The HTSEN state machine shall have states: HTSEN_START_MEAS, HTSEN_READ_RESULTS
The HTSEN_Trigger function shall step through the state machine that handles I2C sensor measurement
The SPS module shall provide headers for the driver for smart power switches
The SPS_Initialize function shall initialize IOs for the SPS driver including register configuration
The SPS_Ctrl function shall be called time-triggered every 10ms and must not be re-entrant
The SPS_RequestContactorState function shall request contactor state for channels affiliated with SPS_AFF_CONTACTOR
The SPS_GetChannelCurrentFeedback function shall compare measured current with threshold to determine contactor state
Each SPS IC shall have 4 outputs (SPS_NR_CONTACTOR_PER_IC = 4)
The SPS shall use 2 ICs in daisy-chain (SPS_NR_OF_IC = 2)
The SPS current measurement LSB shall be 0.98mA (SPS_I_MEASUREMENT_LSB_mA)
The SPS shall recognize contactor as closed when current exceeds 20mA threshold (SPS_CHANNEL_ON_DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_mA)
The SPS state machine shall have states: SPS_START, SPS_RESET_LOW, SPS_RESET_HIGH, SPS_CONFIGURE_CONTROL_REGISTER, SPS_TRIGGER_CURRENT_MEASUREMENT, SPS_READ_MEASURED_CURRENT1-4, SPS_READ_EN_IRQ_PIN
The SPS shall validate channelIndex is less than SPS_NR_OF_AVAILABLE_SPS_CHANNELS
The SPS shall validate channelFunction is either SPS_CHANNEL_OFF or SPS_CHANNEL_ON
The SPS channel affiliation types shall be SPS_AFF_CONTACTOR or SPS_AFF_GENERAL_IO
The contactor module shall provide headers for the driver for contactors
The CONT_GetContactorState function shall return the current contactor state from CONT_ELECTRICAL_STATE_TYPE_e
The CONT_OpenContactor function shall make an open state request to the specific contactor
The CONT_CloseContactor function shall make a close state request to the specific contactor
The CONT_OpenAllContactors function shall open all contactors
The CONT_CheckFeedback function shall make a DIAG entry for each contactor when feedback does not match set value
The contactor states shall be CONT_SWITCH_OFF (open), CONT_SWITCH_ON (closed), CONT_SWITCH_UNDEFINED
The contactor feedback types shall be CONT_FEEDBACK_NORMALLY_OPEN, CONT_FEEDBACK_NORMALLY_CLOSED, CONT_FEEDBACK_THROUGH_CURRENT, CONT_HAS_NO_FEEDBACK
The contactor types shall be CONT_PLUS (HV plus path), CONT_MINUS (HV minus path), CONT_PRECHARGE, CONT_UNDEFINED
The contactor shall validate stringNumber is less than BS_NR_OF_STRINGS
The contactor shall validate contactor type is not CONT_UNDEFINED
The contactor shall validate SPS channel is less than SPS_NR_OF_AVAILABLE_SPS_CHANNELS
The contactor shall validate channel affiliation is SPS_AFF_CONTACTOR
The contactor state machine shall trap on undefined contactor type (FAS_TRAP)
The CAN module shall provide header for the driver for the CAN communication interface
The CAN shall support 64 message boxes (CAN_TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_MESSAGE_BOXES) for TMS570LC4357
The CAN shall define 32 TX message boxes (CAN_NR_OF_TX_MESSAGE_BOX) out of 64 total
The CAN TX function shall be called in 10ms task time slot (CAN_TICK_ms)
The CAN_DataSend function shall send data over CAN by marking message boxes for transmission
The CAN_MainFunction shall perform CAN timing checks and send periodic messages
The CAN_ReadRxBuffer shall check received data from buffer because CAN frames are received in interrupt routine
The CAN_Initialize function shall enable the CAN transceiver before using CAN interface
The CAN_EnablePeriodic function shall enable/disable periodic sending to prevent sending uninitialized data
The CAN_IsCurrentSensorPresent function shall return presence flag for current sensor
